name: Pilates Cookies | Bite-Sized Resets
description:
Enjoy a Pilates Cookie — a bite-sized movement ritual to help you find feel-good ease and be where your feet are.

Through mindful movement, we change ourselves from the inside out. By using gravity as our free training tool—and occasionally bringing in small props for immediate feedback—we can quickly restore alignment, clear the mental clutter, and reset our entire state of being in just a few minutes. This is the power of continuously showing up, one bite-sized piece at a time.

This is why we elevate.

#PilatesCookies #BiteSizedRitual #BeWhereYourFeetAre #MindfulMovement #ElevateWithAndy

name: Foundations | Organize & Balance
description:
Skillful movement requires being where your feet are. Awareness is your greatest tool for repatterning—you cannot change what you cannot feel.

We practice stepping out of the crowded thinking space of to-do lists and expanding into your internal landscape—reorganizing protective tension into supportive tone. We anchor into a central axis, balancing structural mobility and stability, mapping a clear line of communication from your core straight out to your fingertips and toes.

This is why we elevate.

#OrganizeYourBody #TensionToTone #SomaticAwareness #ResilienceInMotion #ElevateWithAndy

name: Resilience In Motion | Pilates Apparatus, CoreAlign and Bodhi Suspension Training
description:
Welcome to your digital studio space. This playlist features individual, specialized sessions for the Pilates Apparatus (Reformer, Chair, Tower, Arc), CoreAlign, or Bodhi Suspension System. You do not need access to everything to benefit; simply choose the videos that match the specific apparatus you have in front of you today.

These structured sessions are built on the foundations of the Resilience in Motion Method. Rather than chasing quick fixes, we redirect the focus inward to give our bodies the opportunity to make lasting change from the inside out.

We use the feedback from these specialized, resistance-based pieces of equipment to fine-tune functional mechanics, dynamically load joints, find full-body muscle activation and integration, build deeper physical resilience, and repattern subconscious movement behaviors. The list goes on and on. Join me in this lifetime practice of elevating and moving well.

#ElevateWithAndy #ResilienceInMotionMethod #PilatesApparatus #CoreAlign #Bodhi #FunctionalMovement #BalancedBodyPilates

name: Shadows & Stars: The Wild Experiment
description:
Welcome to a space where thriving is a wild experiment.

This playlist explores creative projects and everyday habits that go way beyond just "moving well"—taking practices out of the studio and releasing them into real life. It’s where artistic endeavors and everyday play collide.

From deep-diving into D&D characters and digging in the yard, to hanging with furred and feathered friends... it’s all part of the practice.

This is where we find our feet in the dark together, walking amongst the shadows to find our stars.

#WildExperiment #CreativeWellBeing #EmbodiedLiving #DNDCommunity #ElevateWithAndy
